pages.text: Look for broad stacked leaves in the tall-crop biomes. A farmer can stock seeds. Plant seeds on farmland, dirt or grass and keep the stalk well lit with room for its second section.

pages.title: Bring Leaves Home
pages.text: Break mature sections for leaves and more seeds. Dry nine leaves at a time and use the dried leaves in $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/tobacco)smoking recipes$(/l).
